_readme: Fill pexelsId (the number in a pexels.com/photo/... URL) for each slot you want, then run `npm run images:fetch`. Leave null to keep the placeholder. Every photo must be a different Pexels photo. tier 'demo-minimum' = the smallest set that makes the demo look right (covers of tenant-visible homes + 6 owner-pool images).
